target_location: n/a — merged into the NotificationService row
ledger_correction: App\Services\MailService does not exist. Outbound mail is dispatched from exactly two places: App\Services\NotificationService and App\Http\Controllers\Auth\ForgotPasswordController. Both are now covered by the NotificationService row.

Two corrections. (1) The ledger proposed three targets including NotificationServiceInterface and SmsContractInterface; there is no SMS gateway anywhere in the codebase and NotificationService is not an interface, so only the mail port was extracted. (2) NotificationService is not the only place the Mail facade was used — ForgotPasswordController also called Mail::to() directly, contradicting the class docblock. Both now go through MailContractInterface, so the stated invariant actually holds.

responsibility: Handle media processing and storage operations
ledger_correction: Two corrections. (1) The class lives at app/Helpers/MediaHelper.php, not app/Services/MediaHelper.php. (2) It used no Storage facade at all — the filesystem writes are raw mkdir/copy/file_put_contents against a path it computes itself — so the proposed StorageContractInterface dependency was wrong. The GD encoding step was extracted; the compression policy (70KB target, 80-to-20 quality ladder) deliberately stayed in the helper. The port is expressed in bytes rather than GD handles so it does not leak the extension.

target_location: n/a — replaced by the MediaService + ProfileService storage rows
ledger_correction: App\Services\UploadService does not exist. The real service-layer consumers of the Storage facade are App\Services\MediaService and App\Services\ProfileService, both of which are now behind StorageContractInterface. Nine Storage:: call sites across 6 controllers (AuthorController, SuccessStoryController, GalleryController, ScreenController, ScreenProviderPortalController, JobApplicationController) also use the facade directly; those were deliberately left alone this phase to avoid touching unrelated features, and are recorded as deferred.
